Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly extract the nationality from the Wikipedia page it visited in Step 10. While the page's JSON-LD metadata explicitly stated `"nationality": "English"`, the visible text of the article described Tracy Flannigan as an "independent filmmaker residing in the Echo Park area of Los Angeles" and working in the "United States," strongly implying she is American. The agent incorrectly prioritized the machine-generated JSON-LD field (which was likely an error in the Wikipedia data itself) over the actual article content and the overwhelming contextual evidence (Los Angeles residence, US film festivals) that pointed to her being American. This led to a false conclusion of "English" nationality, contradicting the film's description as an "American documentary" and the agent's own later search results which correctly identified her as American.
